content.title: CBS Sports and TNT Sports announce tip times and matchups for second round games on Saturday, March 21 | NCAA.com
content.text: CBS Sports and TNT Sports announce tip times and matchups for second round games on Saturday, March 21 | NCAA.com Skip to main content PRESENTED BY 00:00/00:00 DI Men's Basketball High Point vs. Wisconsin - First round NCAA tournament extended highlights High Point vs. Wisconsin - First round highlights Share TNT Sports and CBS Sports have announced tip times and matchups for Second Round coverage of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball Championship on Saturday, March 21 (Noon-Midnight ET), with all 67 games available live in their entirety across four national television networks – TBS, CBS, TNT and truTV – and NCAA March Madness Live. Games airing on TBS, TNT and truTV will also stream live on HBO Max. Games airing on CBS will also stream live on Paramount+. Following are tip times and commentator assignments for Saturday’s Second Round games. Tip times for the Second Round games on Sunday, March 22, will be announced on Friday after the conclusion of the day’s games. Below are the previously announced tip times and commentator assignments for First Round action on Friday, March 20, with coverage beginning at Noon, ET. Follow us on X (@MM_MBB_TV) and NCAA.com for schedule updates and the latest NCAA tournament broadcast news and information. Watch the shot that kept the Wolverines alive, from every angle here. 4:16 PM GMT UPCOMING Chris Paul's top March Madness highlights Before he dominated defenses in the NBA, Chris Paul led Wake Forest to back-to-back NCAA tournaments from 2004-05. Paul won the ACC Rookie of the Year and was named a First Team Consensus All-American before declaring for the 2005 NBA Draft. 4:29 PM GMT UPCOMING Watch Michael Jordan's best NCAA tournament highlights Michael Jordan spent three years under coach Dean Smith at UNC, leaving with a national championship and an incredible legacy. Watch MJ's best plays from all three of his NCAA tournament runs with the Tar Heels. 4:40 PM GMT UPCOMING Jimmer Fredette's NCAA tournament highlights, top plays Jimmer Fredette went to the NCAA tournament in all of his four years with BYU, reaching the Sweet 16 as a senior. Watch all of Jimmer's best March Madness highlights as a Cougar (2007-11) here. 4:50 PM GMT UPCOMING Jordan Poole's 2018 buzzer beater to beat Houston, from every angle With Houston up late, it looked like Michigan's season was over in the second round of the 2018 NCAA tournament — until Jordan Poole's 28-foot heave found the bottom of the net and sent the freshman scrambling around the court in celebration. Watch every angle of the buzzer beater here. 4:52 PM GMT UPCOMING David Robinson's incredible 50-point performance in 1987 first round In The Admiral's final game with the Navy Midshipmen, he finished his historic college career with a bang, scoring 50 points. Watch every point from David Robinson's incredible performance against Michigan in the 1987 NCAA tournament here. 4:59 PM GMT UPCOMING Verne Lundquist's greatest March Madness calls Relive some of Verne Lundquist's most iconic calls when he broadcasted some March Madness classics. 5:03 PM GMT UPCOMING Magic vs. Bird: Top plays from their legendary 1979 NCAA title game battle In the massive 1979 NCAA title game, a career-long rivalry began between basketball legends Magic Johnson and Larry Bird. Magic and the Michigan State Spartans got the best of Bird's Indiana State Sycamores, 75-64. Watch all the highlights from their legendary matchup here. 5:07 PM GMT UPCOMING Steve Nash highlights: NCAA tournament top plays NBA legend and two-time MVP Steve Nash played in three NCAA tournaments as a Santa Clara Bronco, including a 15-over-2 seed upset against Arizona in 1993, the second of its kind at the time. Watch all of his best tournament highlights here. 5:11 PM GMT UPCOMING Zion vs. Tacko: Watch highlights from their incredible second-round battle The battle between Zion Williamson and Tacko Fall lived up to the hype. Watch his 2025 March Madness highlights here. 6:12 PM GMT UPCOMING The wild buzzer beater to save Virginia's 2019 title run, from every angle Mamadi Diakite kept Virginia's title run alive with a last-second shot to send their legendary Elite Eight battle with Purdue into OT, where the Cavs prevailed 80-75. Watch every angle of the buzzer beater here. 6:14 PM GMT UPCOMING Markquis Nowell breaks NCAA tournament record with 19 assists Markquis Nowell put on a show at Madison Square Garden, scoring 20 points to go with an NCAA tournament record 19 assists. Watch all of Nowell's jaw-dropping highlights from Kansas State's Sweet 16 win over Michigan State here 6:19 PM GMT UPCOMING Watch Shaquille O'Neal set NCAA block record en route to a triple-double Watch Shaquille O'Neal set an NCAA block record with 11 blocks en route to triple-double in LSU's 1992 opening round match-up against BYU. 6:24 PM GMT UPCOMING Every Final Four Most Outstanding Player from 1979-2019 From Magic Johnson to Kyle Guy, there are many notable names in the list of Most Outstanding Player awards since 1979. Watch highlights and learn some facts about previous Final Four MOP winners here. 6:34 PM GMT UPCOMING Jim Nantz's greatest March Madness calls Jim Nantz has announced the 2023 NCAA tournament will be his last. Take a look back at some of his most iconic calls in his 30-plus years doing March Madness play-by-play for CBS.
